sBPF VM state, memory mapping, validation, and execution APIs.

# Purpose
`fd_vm.h` defines the public interface and data layout for an sBPF virtual machine. It declares the opaque `fd_vm_t` type, the VM shadow state, input memory region records, and account-region metadata used to map transaction accounts into VM memory. The `fd_vm` structure stores VM configuration, program image data, execution state, memory maps, stack and heap storage, tracing state, feature flags, and fault information. It also defines alignment, footprint, and magic-value constants used to allocate and validate VM storage.

The file also declares the main VM lifecycle and execution APIs: [`fd_vm_new`](<#fd_vm_new>), [`fd_vm_join`](<#fd_vm_join>), [`fd_vm_init`](<#fd_vm_init>), [`fd_vm_leave`](<#fd_vm_leave>), [`fd_vm_delete`](<#fd_vm_delete>), [`fd_vm_validate`](<#fd_vm_validate>), and the execution entry points [`fd_vm_exec_trace`](<#fd_vm_exec_trace>), [`fd_vm_exec_notrace`](<#fd_vm_exec_notrace>), and [`fd_vm_exec`](<#fd_vm_exec>). These functions support creation, initialization, validation, execution, and teardown of a VM instance. The header also exposes helper functions that control memory-check behavior based on deprecated-program state, and it includes the program and syscall interfaces needed for VM execution.
